description: A construction cost escalation index for data centres in the United States is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sweta Dutta. Code and public data for a monthly fixed-weight Laspeyres input-cost index for data-centre construction in the United States, 2005-2026, with escalation decomposition, an office-index drift test, and a forecast benchmark. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
